fakerphp/faker.capabilities: Fake data for factories and seeders (names, addresses, phone numbers, lorem, locale-aware generators incl. ru_RU).
fakerphp/faker.reuse: All model factories; realistic uz/ru listing fixtures for tests and local seeding.

inertiajs/inertia-laravel.capabilities: Server-driven SPA adapter (Inertia v3): page rendering, shared props, deferred/merge props, SSR.
inertiajs/inertia-laravel.reuse: None — frozen starter UI (ADR-0002). Do not add Inertia pages.
inertiajs/inertia-laravel.boost_skill: inertia-react-development (do not load for HOMI work)

larastan/larastan.capabilities: PHPStan with Laravel awareness (Eloquent, facades, container). Level 7 configured in phpstan.neon.
larastan/larastan.reuse: Quality gate in composer types:check / CI for all backend code.

laravel/ai.capabilities: Official Laravel AI SDK: unified text/structured-output/embeddings/audio across providers (Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Groq, Ollama, OpenRouter, xAI, Bedrock, Azure OpenAI…), tools, agents, MCP integration.
laravel/ai.reuse: Owner/realtor classification, free-text radar query parsing, translations, voice transcription (about.md). Provider chosen later via env (checkpoint AI).

laravel/boost.capabilities: AI-assisted development: MCP server (search-docs, database-schema, database-query, browser-logs, get-absolute-url), generated guidelines (AGENTS.md) and skills per installed package.
laravel/boost.reuse: Agents use its MCP and skills for every backend task; `php artisan boost:update` after dependency changes.

laravel/dusk.capabilities: Browser (ChromeDriver) end-to-end tests with Pest/PHPUnit; page objects, screenshots on failure.
laravel/dusk.reuse: Only for the frozen backend UI or admin dashboards; Next.js apps use Playwright instead.

laravel/framework.capabilities: Laravel 13: routing, Eloquent (PostgreSQL), validation, API Resources, queues, cache, events, notifications, filesystem (Flysystem), scheduler, broadcasting, rate limiting, encryption, HTTP client with retries, localization.
laravel/framework.reuse: Everything first: validation, authorization policies, API Resources, queues, cache, Storage, Http client, RateLimiter — before any package.

laravel/horizon.capabilities: Redis queue supervisor + dashboard: per-queue workers, auto-balancing, metrics, failed-job retry, tags, notifications.
laravel/horizon.reuse: Queue worker for ingest, media variants, radar notifications, bot updates (ADR-0005). Dashboard at /horizon.

laravel/mcp.capabilities: Build MCP servers in Laravel (tools, resources, prompts) over HTTP or stdio with auth.
laravel/mcp.reuse: Candidate for exposing HOMI data/tools to AI agents (e.g. listing search tool for the bot) — no decision yet.

laravel/pail.capabilities: Tail application logs in the terminal with filters; part of `php artisan dev`.

laravel/pao.capabilities: Agent-optimized compact test output for Pest/PHPUnit (`php artisan test --compact`).
laravel/pao.reuse: Default test runner output for AI agents to save tokens.

laravel/pennant.capabilities: Feature flags: class/closure features, per-scope values, database/array drivers, rich values, purging.
laravel/pennant.reuse: Closed-beta gating (waitlist), gradual rollout of radar/AI features per user or segment.

laravel/pint.reuse: Mandatory after every PHP edit: `vendor/bin/pint --dirty --format agent`.

laravel/pulse.capabilities: Real-time application performance dashboard: slow queries/requests/jobs, exceptions, cache hit rate, queue sizes, usage per user.
laravel/pulse.reuse: Observability baseline (master prompt §17) at /pulse; disabled in tests.

laravel/reverb.capabilities: First-party WebSocket server for Laravel broadcasting (Pusher protocol), scaling via Redis.
laravel/reverb.reuse: Candidate for live feed updates / radar pushes to the web app; Telegram remains the primary notification channel. Decide with the first real-time feature.

laravel/sanctum.capabilities: API token authentication (personal access tokens with abilities and expiry) and optional SPA cookie auth.
laravel/sanctum.reuse: Bearer-token auth for all clients (ADR-0003); abilities per app (app:*, arm:*).

laravel/sail.capabilities: Docker Compose dev environment for Laravel.
laravel/sail.reuse: Not used — local env is Homebrew nginx/php-fpm (ADR-0008); Docker CLI absent.

laravel/scout.capabilities: Full-text search abstraction over Meilisearch/Typesense/Algolia/database drivers with model syncing.
laravel/scout.reuse: Candidate for listing search if PostgreSQL full-text/trigram is insufficient; measure first (master prompt §17).

laravel/socialite.capabilities: OAuth 1/2 login providers (Google, GitHub, …) and community providers.
laravel/socialite.reuse: Not needed for Telegram login (hash verification is custom, ported from app.uz); keep for possible Google/Apple login later.

laravel/telescope.capabilities: Local debug assistant: requests, queries, jobs, exceptions, logs, mail, cache, Redis, scheduled tasks.
laravel/telescope.reuse: Local/staging debugging at /telescope; disabled in production and tests.

laravel/tinker.reuse: Ad-hoc inspection (`php artisan tinker --execute`); prefer tests over tinker scripts.

laravel/wayfinder.capabilities: Generates TypeScript functions for Laravel routes/controllers for the Inertia front end.
laravel/wayfinder.reuse: None — belongs to the frozen starter UI (ADR-0002). Next.js apps use the OpenAPI-generated client instead.
laravel/wayfinder.boost_skill: wayfinder-development (do not load for HOMI work)

mockery/mockery.reuse: Mocking external HTTP (Telegram, S3) where Http::fake / Storage::fake are not enough.

nunomaduro/collision.capabilities: Readable console error reporting for artisan and tests.

pestphp/pest.capabilities: Pest 5 testing framework: expectations, datasets, architecture tests, parallel runs, snapshot/browser plugins.
pestphp/pest.reuse: All backend tests (feature-first); architecture tests for module boundaries.

pestphp/pest-plugin-laravel.capabilities: Laravel helpers for Pest (`actingAs`, `get`, `postJson`, artisan test command).
